description: Check the device in; record the customer, device, symptoms, and consent on the intake form and in SYS-01; quote the repair; print the device tag
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 22 tickets a business day; walk-in customers leave for a competitor if they cannot check in; about $3,600 of revenue a day depends on new and returning tickets
manual_workaround: Paper intake form and numbered paper tags; enter tickets into SYS-01 when it returns (same day)
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Counter Associates; Shop Manager; front counter

description: Diagnose and repair devices at the bench; order and fit parts; update the ticket; test the device before release
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Repair labor is most of the revenue; about 60 customer devices are in custody at any time and promised dates slip after one day; battery work needs safe handling
manual_workaround: Work from the paper tag and the printed ticket list; record work on paper; diagnostic tools run offline on the bench PCs
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; parts distributors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Senior Technician; 2 Repair Technicians; back repair room

description: Take payment on the P2PE terminals (including phone payments keyed into a terminal); check ID or the claim ticket; release the device; close the ticket
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No payment means no release and no revenue; releasing a device to the wrong person is a privacy and theft problem; PCI DSS terms require card data only in the P2PE terminals
manual_workaround: Terminals run in standalone mode without SYS-01; paper release log with the customer's signature and ID check; ticket closed later
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; ticketing and POS vendor; internet provider

description: Copy customer data to a new device; recover data from working or lightly damaged devices to the bench storage; send severe cases to the outside lab
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 380 jobs a year (about 7 a week); jobs can wait 2 to 3 days with notice to the customer; a lost staging copy can usually be copied again from the customer's device
manual_workaround: Pause new jobs; tell customers the new date; finish transfers directly device to device where the tool allows

description: Phone calls, status texts and emails from SYS-01, the shared repairs mailbox, and the AI assistant on website chat and text
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers ask for status several times per repair; unanswered messages turn into poor online reviews within a day
manual_workaround: Counter Associates call customers from the printed ticket list; a website banner gives the shop phone number
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; productivity suite vendor; phone carrier

description: Order parts from distributors; receive and track parts and serial numbers in SYS-01
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most parts arrive in 1 to 2 days; a 3-day stop delays repairs but common parts are kept in stock
manual_workaround: Order by phone or the distributors' websites from the Owner's laptop; count stock by hand
dependent_third_parties: Parts distributors; ticketing and POS vendor

description: Monthly invoices to 18 business accounts; ACH and check deposits; bookkeeping and biweekly payroll through the outside service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices go out monthly; payroll runs biweekly through the outside service; a cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; invoices are sent a few days late
dependent_third_parties: Outside bookkeeper and payroll service; productivity suite vendor; MSP

description: Accept devices for recycling; wipe them; store them for the quarterly e-waste pickup
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Free service with no revenue; devices can wait in the locked cage for a week; disposal law (Fla. Stat. 501.171(8)) requires customer records to be made unreadable, so devices must not leave unwiped
manual_workaround: Stop accepting drop-offs; keep received devices locked until wiping resumes
